parsed_json.up: Select activities for compounds tested against human TRPV1 (CHEMBL4794) that have a SMILES string and are reported in a publication with a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, then to docs via assays.doc_id. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce the presence of canonical_smiles. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Alias the molecule identifier as compound_chembl_id. Coalesce docs.doi and docs.pubmed_id into a single column pubmed_id_or_doi, preferring DOI over PMID if both exist. Return columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
